_comment: Single source of truth for Aristotle v4.0. Faithful encoding of 'Capital_Flywheel_Master_Operating_Plan' (controlling doc, Aug 8 2026). LIVE money, two Schwab IRAs, ADVISORY-ONLY. Scanner + reconciler both read this file. Edit values here.
source_hierarchy: Master Operating Plan (controls daily execution + reconciliation)
note_accounts: Performance is measured COMBINED. Risk/assignment/concentration is enforced PER-IRA. No margin, cash-secured only. Do NOT infer an IRA's net liq from its cash balance; use current account equity.

objective.basis: combined month-start net liquidation value, flow-adjusted
objective.no_force: The return target NEVER overrides market gate, trend gates, cash reserve, concentration limits, IV rules, earnings rules, or assignment comfort. Cash is a valid position.
objective.return_math_note: 5% premium ROC closed at 50% target = ~2.5% of collateral; at 50% deployed = ~1.25% of portfolio. Hitting 5%/mo needs turnover + multiple cycles + CC income, not forced weak trades.

capital._note: total_reference is fallback only. Reconciler overrides with live combined net-liq.

position_rules.size_measure: assignment value / capital at risk (strike x 100 x contracts)
position_rules.scaled_concentration_note: User decision 2026-08-08: per-ticker combined cap 10%->20% for ALL watchlist tickers (to lean into TQQQ/SOXL), but ONLY via multiple entries - any single entry <=10% (max_single_entry_pct); reach 20% only by scaling in over 2+ entries. Per-IRA cap 25%->50% so a full 20%-of-combined position may sit in one IRA. This intentionally overrides the Master Operating Plan's 10%/25% hard caps.
position_rules.entry_scaling_note: Intended size = max allowed by setup tier AND all caps (not automatically 10%). Never add because a position is losing.
position_rules.no_immediate_reentry: After a profitable close, do NOT auto re-enter the same extended ticker; wait for a fresh qualifying pullback.

trade_params._note: Machine-readable scalars for flash_check.py / scanner. Mirrors dte_modes + iv_overlay + strike_selection + exit_rules below.
trade_params.flash_note: FLASH CHECK shows top N OTM ~delta_target puts across flash_dte_min..max, ranked by capital efficiency (ROC/day) so short-dated fast-turnover CSPs surface. Group favors <30 DTE.

aggression_profile._comment: User decision 2026-08-29: 'a bit more aggressive' = BALANCED. Aristotle's DEFAULT recommendations lean here. Does NOT override hard gates (QQQ / trend / IV / earnings / concentration / reserve floor). Cash remains a valid position; the 5% is a target, not a mandate. Purpose: capture MORE qualified setups + dial premium deliberately, never force weak trades.
aggression_profile.deploy_target_note: Radar nudges toward ~60% deployed of combined net liq WHEN qualified setups exist. Hard ceiling stays deployed_absolute_max_pct (0.70); reserve floor stays cash_reserve_floor_pct (0.30).

assignment_mode.note: Higher-premium, assignment-acceptable strikes surface ONLY when daily AND weekly trend are strong AND the strike sits at/below computed support (would-be assignment = a good entry relative to the trend). Otherwise fall back to income delta_target.

layering.note: Surfaces add-a-tranche opportunities on qualified uptrend names at smaller pullbacks (>= -1.5%) or a hold of the fast/medium cloud, provided single-ticker headroom remains and each single entry stays <= max_single_entry_pct.

execution._comment: GATED LIVE EXECUTION (separate entity from the read-only advisory). Master safety switch: enabled_live MUST be true or execute.py refuses to submit (dry-run always allowed). Every live order also needs a matching confirm token + passes re-validation at submit time. User places the first live order; Aristotle never submits autonomously.
execution._pin_note: When true, every --live submit ALSO needs a human PIN (set once via `python execute.py set-pin`; stored key-stretched in git-ignored execution_auth.json). Desk: you're prompted for it (no shell history). Phone: you reply it to Aristotle over Telegram and the agent passes it once. The PIN is what stops the agent self-firing without your live participation. NOT airtight vs a compromised same-machine agent (nothing on one box is) but bounds risk to your live, per-order approval + the code gates.

watchlists.review: weekly; a ticker that loses qualification stays manageable as an existing position but is removed from new-entry eligibility until it re-qualifies.

qqq_gate.green: 2+ QQQ daily clouds bullish AND no abnormal selling volume -> proceed
qqq_gate.hold: 2+ QQQ daily clouds bearish OR decline on volume > 20-day avg -> NO new CSPs, manage/reduce
qqq_gate.override: NO TRADE always overrides tactical cash deployment. Excess cash is never permission to trade through a QQQ red flag.

ticker_trend_gate.rule: Both daily AND weekly must be >=2/3 bullish. If daily and weekly disagree, weekly wins -> no new trade.
ticker_trend_gate.double_red_cloud_exit: 2 weekly clouds turning bearish = mandatory exit signal for long-biased positions.

entry_ladder.universe: Core first; Flex only if exceptional

intraday_pullback._comment: TACTICAL_INTRADAY mode — Rev 1.4. Overrides ONLY the NO_TRADE (green day) tier. All hard gates remain controlling.
intraday_pullback.override_scope: NO_TRADE only — does NOT override QQQ, trend, IV, liquidity, earnings, or sizing hard-gate failures
intraday_pullback.dte_preference: tactical_weekly (7-15 DTE); standard flywheel (25-45 DTE) acceptable if weekly mode has no liquid strikes
intraday_pullback.all_other_gates_unchanged: 10% ticker / 25% IRA / IV floor+danger / liquidity / QQQ gate / trend gates / assignment comfort / exit-order discipline

cash_state_ladder.permission: A+, A, and qualified B weekly setups
A+ only; additions must be exceptional
NO new entries; close winners / rebuild cash

strike_selection.start: OTM at a price where assignment is acceptable
strike_selection.do_not_force: If the only strike hitting the return target needs bad delta/weak support/uncomfortable assignment -> WATCH/NO TRADE.

order_discipline.entry: SELL TO OPEN put, LIMIT near mid, Day TIF
order_discipline.avoid_windows: first ~15 min and last ~5 min unless urgent risk mgmt
order_discipline.post_fill_exit: immediately place BUY TO CLOSE at 50% of entry credit, GTC

exit_rules.fast_profit: 25-40% of max profit in 1-2 days may be harvested early when turnover is superior or underlying extended
exit_rules.same_ticker_reentry_triggers: ~5% single-day decline OR ~15% decline over 7 days (else only B tactical)

standard_churn.strike: ~5-10% above price or near desired exit

trend_expansion.strike: do not cap major upside too early

covered_calls.basis_protection: Do NOT sell a covered call materially below adjusted cost basis unless the explicit plan is to exit shares at a realized loss.
covered_calls.cost_basis_formula: strike - put premium received, then further reduced by realized covered-call premium
covered_calls.post_fill_exit: 50% GTC Buy to Close immediately after fill

earnings_rule: No new individual-stock CSP if earnings occurs before expiration. NVDA is a single stock -> its earnings apply directly. Single-stock leveraged ETFs (AMZU=AMZN, METU=META, GGLL=GOOGL, NVDL=NVDA): check the UNDERLYING mega-cap earnings even though the ETF does not report. ETHU tracks Ether (no earnings) but is very high-vol -> treat IV danger zone strictly.

correction_protocol.note: Signals raise confidence after a selloff; they do NOT suspend hard risk limits (10% ticker / 25% IRA / 30% cash / 70% deployment).
signals: liquidity sweep of a low with rejection
